_note: Categories shown in 'What we sell'. Each one also gets its own page at /pieces/<slug>. Add stock to a category by appending to its 'pieces' array: { "id": "unique-id", "title": "What it is", "image": "/images/file.jpg", "alt": "Plain description for screen readers", "width": 0, "height": 0, "note": "optional one-liner, e.g. weight or carat" }. Put the photo in public/images first and record where it came from in assets/SOURCES.md. An empty array is fine: the page then invites an enquiry instead of showing stock. Set show:false to hide a category. enquiryItem pre-fills the enquiry form. The 59 pieces added on 5 Oct 2026 live in public/images/pieces/<slug>/; their transparent cut-outs are in assets/source/cutouts/ and scripts/product-card.mjs re-renders the background.
